intermediate.name: Col des Croix
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Col des Croix (157.4 km)

story: The stage saw a delayed breakaway without Pedersen, prompting Lidl Trek to close the gap. Pedersen later joined the lead group, which swelled to 56 riders. Climbs thinned the pack to 10 contenders. Tejada attacked, Schmid countered, winning the final sprint. Pidcock moved up to 4th overall.
